No portable cups, mugs, bottles or food vessels. Make the lower-left 25% open tiled floor. Keep major appliances and sink comfortably above that foreground.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: full-body transparent game avatar illustration for Night Shift at RATiRadio. Reference image 2 provides the authoritative human face inside the storyboard frame: tousled medium brown hair, green iris on the VIEWER'S LEFT, blue iris on the VIEWER'S RIGHT. Open-collar off-white button shirt with rolled sleeves, charcoal high-waisted trousers, plain worn brown shoes, relaxed capable stance, quiet attentive expression. Asset type: ONE transparent production sprite atlas containing six completely separate quest-object illustrations for Night Shift at RATiRadio, arranged precisely in a 3-column × 2-row grid. Reference image 1 supplies the approved item designs and worn teal/amber painterly anime style. This is a clean unlettered atlas for mechanical separation into six square cards. Large transparent gutters between cells; nothing overlaps a grid boundary. All six objects fully visible, centered with generous breathing room in their cells. Top row left to right: 1) one aged brass Station Key on a small metal ring with a worn dark red-brown leather tag; 2) one deep rust-red knitted Beanie with thick folded ribbed cuff, softly slumped, no logo; 3) one upright battered dark-teal metal Thermos with dull silver screw cap and cream unlettered scuffed label. Bottom row left to right: 4) one small glossy BLACK CERAMIC Raven Figurine on a tiny integrated oval base, rigid sculpted wings, glossy glaze, obviously an inanimate ornament, no colored live eyes; 5) one ordinary clear drinking Glass HALF FULL of clean water, no hand, subtly faceted base and painted highlights with translucent glass edges; 6) one worn cream paper Request Slip with three short faint illegible graphite lines and a small plain pencil resting diagonally across it. No legible letters or numbers. Genuine transparent background everywhere outside each object, no beige page, no checkerboard baked in, no shelves, no floor, no cast shadows connecting objects. No labels, borders, dividers, title, UI, characters, living bird or duplicate objects. Consistent scale appropriate to a six-cell item atlas; each object occupies about 65–75% of its cell. Wide 3:2 overall canvas, preferably 1536×1024 or larger.
